name: ABVD (Doxorubicin + Bleomycin + Vinblastine + Dacarbazine)

biomarkers.CD30: typically expressed on Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells but NOT a gate for ABVD
biomarkers.note: ABVD is a cytotoxic four-drug backbone and is not biomarker-restricted for eligibility. CD30 is characteristically expressed by Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells but does not gate access to ABVD (CD30 targeting is the rationale for brentuximab-vedotin-containing regimens, not ABVD). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma, v2.2026.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for newly diagnosed classical Hodgkin lymphoma (early-stage favorable, early-stage unfavorable, and advanced-stage disease)
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) therapy for classical Hodgkin lymphoma; ABVD is a category 1 primary treatment option

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, HODG-B (Principles of Systemic Therapy); ABVD listed as Doxorubicin/Bleomycin/Vinblastine/Dacarbazine (line 1922); ABVD category 1 (line 972, HODG-7D)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate pulmonary reserve for bleomycin (DLCO generally acceptable at >=60%)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, footnote h (line 407): in general a DLCO threshold of >=60% is acceptable for use of bleomycin; baseline DLCO if ABVD is used (line 365)

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Hodgkin lymphoma chapter, line 330594: ABVD x4 vs ABVD x2 is associated with an additional 100 mg/m2 of doxorubicin. Two additional cycles = 100 mg/m2, i.e. 50 mg/m2 per cycle across days 1 and 15 = 25 mg/m2 per dose.

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 330594 (ABVD x4 adds 100 mg/m2 of doxorubicin over ABVD x2). 100 mg/m2 over two additional cycles is 50 mg/m2 per 28-day cycle, delivered as 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15. Anthracycline: track cumulative lifetime dose (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2). NCCN Hodgkin also notes CMT may be preferred where the doxorubicin dose would exceed 200 mg/m2 (line 580).

drugs.name: Bleomycin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Drug pharmacology table, Bleomycin (Blenoxane) monograph, lines 28406 to 28408: 10 U/m2 IV days 1 and 15 every 28 days for Hodgkin.

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., lines 28406 to 28408. Bleomycin 10 units/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 every 28 days for Hodgkin. Dosed in units/m2 (BSA). Cumulative-dose pulmonary toxicity: caution >400 total units and monitor DLCO; hold for pulmonary toxicity. NCCN Hodgkin: baseline DLCO if ABVD used (line 365); DLCO >=60% generally acceptable for bleomycin (line 407); consider PFTs after 4 cycles (line 587).

drugs.name: vinBLAStine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 10.1 (antineoplastic drug reference), Vinblastine entry, line 20773: 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 as part of ABVD.

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 10.1, line 20773. vinBLAStine 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 as part of ABVD. ISMP tall-man vinBLAStine (distinct from vinCRIStine).

drugs.name: Dacarbazine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY: dacarbazine ABVD dose not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts (dacarbazine doses found are melanoma-specific, 850 to 1000 mg/m2, lines 233416 and 235202). Days 1 and 15 follow the shared ABVD q28 schedule confirmed for bleomycin (line 28406) and vinblastine (line 20773).

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. The commonly cited ABVD dacarbazine dose is 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15, but no source locator for it appears in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts, so the numeric dose must be verified against the source before activation. Basis (BSA/mg/m2) and the days 1 and 15 q28 schedule follow the shared ABVD schedule grounded for bleomycin and vinblastine.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: dacarbazine is highly emetogenic; give antiemetic prophylaxis before ABVD per emetogenicity tier.

supportiveCare: G-CSF: routine use of growth factors is not recommended with ABVD; neutropenia is not a factor for treatment delay or dose reduction with ABVD (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma v2.2026, HODG-B, lines 585 to 586).

Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity: baseline and periodic DLCO; consider PFTs after 4 cycles of ABVD (line 587); DLCO >=60% generally acceptable for continued bleomycin (line 407); discontinue bleomycin for pulmonary toxicity.
Antiemetics: dacarbazine highly emetogenic; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each dose
baseline and periodic DLCO / pulmonary function (bleomycin); consider PFTs after 4 cycles
cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2)

doseModificationRules.condition: new or worsening pulmonary symptoms or falling DLCO
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or discontinue bleomycin for suspected pulmonary toxicity; clinical review.

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC or platelet nadir on day 1
doseModificationRules.text: Note: NCCN Hodgkin states neutropenia is not a factor for ABVD delay or dose reduction (HODG-B); clinical review for day 1 or day 15 counts per protocol.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Table 10.1 vinblastine (line 20773); Bleomycin/Blenoxane monograph (lines 28406 to 28408); Hodgkin chapter doxorubicin cumulative-dose statement (line 330594)

guideline.locator: HODG-B Principles of Systemic Therapy (ABVD = Doxorubicin/Bleomycin/Vinblastine/Dacarbazine, line 1922; G-CSF/neutropenia guidance lines 585 to 587; DLCO footnotes lines 365, 407); ABVD category 1 (line 972, HODG-7D)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for ABVD in classical Hodgkin lymphoma (#74). vinBLAStine 6 mg/m2 IV days 1 and 15 is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. Table 10.1 (line 20773); bleomycin 10 units/m2 IV days 1 and 15 every 28 days for Hodgkin to the DeVita Bleomycin/Blenoxane monograph (lines 28406 to 28408); doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 per dose derived from the DeVita statement that ABVD x4 adds 100 mg/m2 of doxorubicin over ABVD x2 (line 330594), i.e. 50 mg/m2 per 28-day cycle across days 1 and 15. The 28-day cycle length is grounded to the bleomycin monograph (line 28408). Dacarbazine numeric dose is set to VERIFY: no ABVD-specific dacarbazine dose locator appears in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts (dacarbazine doses present are melanoma-specific). Regimen identity, category-1 status, G-CSF/neutropenia guidance and bleomycin DLCO monitoring are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma v2.2026. ISMP tall-man applied (DOXOrubicin, vinBLAStine); anthracycline cumulative cap 450/550 mg/m2; bleomycin dosed in units with a >400-unit cumulative caution and DLCO monitoring. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
